title: easyShop rolls out Klarna across 19 European markets ahead of its first Black Friday | Klarna International
body_markdown:
-


*Klarna is now available on easyShop across 19 European markets*


-


*Shoppers can choose Pay in Full, Pay in 3 or Pay in 30*, with no interest*


-


*The launch comes ahead of easyShop's first Black Friday and Christmas trading season*


**LONDON, 29 October 2026** - easyShop.com, the new online marketplace from the easy® family of brands, has added Klarna, the everyday finance network, to checkout across 19 European markets, giving shoppers a more flexible and transparent way to pay ahead of Black Friday and Christmas.


Customers shopping on easyShop can now choose Klarna's Pay in Full, Pay in 3 or Pay in 30 options, allowing them to pay upfront, split a purchase into three interest-free payments, or pay a month later. All three options are interest free.


The partnership follows easyShop's high-profile launch earlier this month and comes as the marketplace prepares for its first peak trading period.


**Cas Paton, Founder and CEO of OnCommerce, the platform powering easyShop** , said:


"Black Friday is no longer just about finding the best deal. Shoppers also want flexibility in how they pay. By bringing Klarna to easyShop, we're giving customers the freedom to shop in a way that suits them, while helping our sellers capitalise on one of the biggest retail moments of the year.


"The easy family of brands has always been about making things simpler and more accessible. Adding Klarna is another way we’re delivering on that, giving shoppers more choice alongside great products and competitive prices."


**Klarna Interim UK & Ireland Country Lead Alex Rohloff said:**


“One size doesn’t fit all when it comes to payments. Consumers deserve choice, and with Klarna on easyShop, people can now pay on their terms: in full, split into three interest-free payments, or in 30 days, with no interest and a clear end date.”


Klarna is available on easyShop now across 19 European markets.


Shoppers can


[visit easyShop](https://www.easyshop.com/)


.


Retailers can


[register to sell on easyShop](https://www.oncommerce.com/easyshop/)


.


**Klarna payment options vary by country and are subject to eligibility. Terms and conditions apply.*


**Notes to Editors:**


• Klarna is available on easyShop in Austria, Belgium, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the UK.


• Klarna is not currently available on easyShop in Hungary or Slovakia.


• Payment options offered vary by market.


**About easyShop**


[easyShop](https://www.easyshop.com/)


is a multi-category online marketplace operating across 21 European countries. Part of the easy family of brands, founded by Sir Stelios Haji-Ioannou, easyShop is built around value, choice and simplicity. The easyShop brand is owned and licensed by easyGroup, while the marketplace is powered and operated by OnCommerce.


**About OnCommerce**


[OnCommerce](https://www.oncommerce.com/)


is a marketplace technology business that powers and operates easyShop, cashback marketplace OnBuy (est. 2016) and UK electronics marketplace Comet, which launches in November 2026. OnCommerce holds no stock and does not sell own-label products through its marketplaces.


**About Klarna**


Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit Klarna.com.
